request.spec:
A plan may instead run monthly on a day of the month (1 to 31): the plan dates are that day in
every month from the start's month, a day beyond the month's length falling on its last day, dates
before the start left out (PLAN_ADDED ends day=<day> end=<date> instead of every=).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A plan may instead run monthly on a day of the month (1 to 31): the plan dates are that day in
every month from the start's month, a day beyond the month's length falling on its last day, dates
before the start left out (PLAN_ADDED ends day=<day> end=<date> instead of every=).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A plan can now run monthly on a day of the month (1 to 31) instead of every N days, and all 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

**How the dates work:** a monthly plan's dates are that day in every month starting from the start date's month. If the day is beyond a month's length it falls on that month's last day (day 31 gives Feb 28). Dates before the start are left out, and none go past the end or the sheet's today. Each date still makes one claim only, as before.

**Form rules:** the person's plan form has a new "day of month" field (`plan-form-day`). A plan is refused if the day isn't a whole number from 1 to 31, or if both a day and an every-N-days interval are filled in. The second rule is my own addition — the request doesn't cover that case.

**Audit:** for a monthly plan, `PLAN_ADDED` ends `day=<day> end=<date>` in place of `every=`. Every-N-days plans still write the old line.

**Display:** a monthly plan's row shows "monthly on day N".

**What changed:**
- **Stored data:** migration `V76__plan_month_day.sql` adds a `month_day` column to `person_plan` and lets `every_days` be empty. Each plan has one or the other.
- **Server:** the date logic is in `Plan.dates()`, which the generate step now calls. I also updated how a plan is built and checked, saved, returned to the screen and audited.
- **Front end:** the new form field and the row text, in `PersonPlans.tsx` and `plans.ts`.
